{"subject":"Claim C020792 past filing limit - write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C020792 (patient PT0258, service code T1019, 9 units, date of service 2026-09-10, billed $54.90) was submitted on 2026-10-29, 49 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, so the claim is predicted to be denied (D03).

Editing the claim cannot fix this timing issue. I need a write-off decision from you on this claim before it is submitted, so we can close it out correctly. Please let me know your decision as soon as possible.

Thank you."}
